zmena: RP_ASK.rules bez „Do NOT give a new divination“ (charakter beze změny)
otazka: Will i get the job a applied for?
cteni: Beneath the grass, old footprints lie out of sight until the low sun catches each shallow hollow across the field. For a moment, you can see where someone walked; then the light shifts and the trail disappears again. Perth is the rune of what comes into view without staying visible. Kuky, what you cannot yet name may be hidden, or it may still be taking shape.
odpovedi: Kuky, Perth does not say whether you will get the job. It speaks to what is still out of sight. You may learn more about the decision, but that is different from knowing its outcome now.

Kuky, Perth cannot tell you whether you will get the job. In this reading, something remains out of sight: perhaps the employer’s decision, or a detail you have not heard yet. The light catches only part of the path, so the outcome remains open.

Kuky, Perth does not show whether you get the job. It holds the part of the decision you cannot see yet. You may learn something about the role or the hiring process that changes how you understand the outcome, whichever way it falls.
